title: Correct hosted lint regression in finish readiness test
rawUserRequest: Continue the planned Work Items with the temporary efficiency authorization: do not run full local quality when focused verification and all governance gates provide sufficient evidence, but do not weaken quality. Diagnose and permanently correct repeated release and CI process failures.

declaredIntent.summary: Replace archived unmerged PR #520 with a source-bound evidence implementation that also proves the lightweight local path runs static lint before PR creation.

outOfScope: Mutating the archived records or branch of PR #520.
Removing or weakening project lint, formatter, source-bound evidence, hosted CI, or aggregation gates.

sources.reason: Hosted template-smoke proves the archived #520 branch fails only because ruff reports unsorted imports in tests/test_finish_readiness.py.
Archived replacement implementation that cannot be mutated after ai-finish.
Current local PR gate runs only project-format-check, which allowed the static lint regression to escape.
Target regression test and lint failure location.

riskAssessment.reason: The correction touches root and installed Runtime PR gates. It must preserve fail-closed evidence while keeping an intentionally unconfigured generic formatter optional.

executionDecision.reason: The hosted error is deterministic and the complete replacement scope preserves every required gate.

preReviewWarnings: Do not amend #520 archive evidence or relax static lint to make the replacement pass.
The generic stack may skip only its explicitly unconfigured optional formatter; lint and source-bound evidence remain mandatory.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: The source-bound evidence implementation from #520 is independently recreated from origin/main without changing #520's archive.
The root check-ai-pr path runs both formatting and static lint before source-bound evidence and PR aggregation.
The installed generic Runtime does not fail because its intentionally unconfigured placeholder formatter is optional, while source-bound evidence remains enforced.
Focused regression tests, project formatter, project lint, source-bound evidence, required governance gates, and hosted CI pass.
guidelines: Keep evidence and lint gates fail closed for configured projects.
Preserve template and installed Runtime command parity.
Keep the correction minimal and do not modify immutable archive records.

intent.problem: PR #520's source-bound solution was archived before hosted CI exposed an unsorted import. The temporary local-quality exception had skipped project lint, while check-ai-pr ran formatting only. The archived work cannot receive a post-finish commit.
constraints: Use a new Work Item and PR rather than altering archived #520 evidence.
No full local make quality; run formatter, lint, focused tests, source-bound evidence, and all governance gates.
Hosted CI remains mandatory before merge.
intent.rationale: Recreating the implementation on a new branch preserves immutable audit history. Making lint mandatory in the lightweight PR path prevents the exact class of local-versus-hosted regression without restoring slow full quality.

verification.reason: Temporary user-authorized efficiency exception: run focused tests, formatter, lint, source-bound evidence, all governance gates, and mandatory hosted CI instead.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: The user continuously authorized all planned corrective Work Items and explicitly requested permanent process correction without weakening quality.

rollbackNote: Revert this replacement Work Item as one unit; retain #520 and this Work Item's archived evidence.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A newly added test has a ruff import-order violation while full local quality is intentionally skipped.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The lightweight check-ai-pr path fails through project-lint before a PR can be created.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add a regression assertion for project lint in the PR gate and run it against the recreated test.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: An installed generic adopter has no configured formatter command.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The optional formatter is skipped while source-bound evidence and PR checks remain active and pass.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the installed generic Runtime regression and confirm the hosted installation-smoke job passes.
